articles.summary: Second quarter 2025 total revenue was $10.3 million, up 7% from prior year Achieves four consecutive quarters of year-over-year revenue growth Company reaffirms 2025 revenue guidance of $39-42 million HOLLISTER, Calif., Aug. 07, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Alpha Teknova, Inc.
articles.title: Teknova Reports Second Quarter 2025 Financial Results
